topic: How one Oman retail company cut payroll prep from three days to two hours after switching to WPS-integrated payroll
format: Before/after of a single workflow: same task, two completely different experiences
post:
Three days of spreadsheets, bank files, and manual cross-checks.

Then two hours.

That's what one Oman retail company found after moving to SmartPRO Hub's WPS-integrated payroll. Same team. Same payday. The workload just looked nothing like it used to.

Before: their finance manager spent Monday through Wednesday pulling attendance data, calculating deductions, formatting WPS files, and chasing approvals over WhatsApp. One wrong column meant starting over from scratch.

After: payroll runs inside one platform. Attendance feeds in automatically, WPS files generate to Central Bank spec, and the submission goes out without a separate login or export.

72 hours down to 2.

WPS payroll compliance in Oman doesn't have to own half the workweek. It should be something you close before lunch and move on from.

And here's the thing worth saying plainly — the goal isn't doing more with fewer people. It's giving people back time that was never supposed to disappear into manual processes in the first place. That finance manager now has three days a month back. That matters.

What does your team actually do with the hours payroll takes every month?
